{
  "analysis": "check.py passed the Opera Game test successfully (18 positions, all move counts matched). To increase confidence for other test positions, I should run additional edge-case tests comparing against python-chess for castling, en passant, promotion, pins, and checks.",
  "plan": "Run a Python test script that compares the regex solution against python-chess for several carefully chosen FENs covering castling, en passant, promotion, check evasion, pins, and castling rights loss from rook capture.",
  "commands": [
    {
      "keystrokes": "python3 - <<'PY'
import json, re, chess

def all_legal_next_positions(fen):
    for pattern, repl in json.load(open("/app/re.json")):
        fen = re.sub(pattern, repl, fen)
    return fen.split("\n")

def run_solution(fen):
    return [" ".join(x.split(" ")[:-2]) for x in all_legal_next_positions(fen)]

tests = [
    "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq - 0 1",
    "rnbqkbnr/ppp1pppp/8/3p4/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq d6 0 2",
    "r3k2r/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/R3K2R w KQkq - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/pppppppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/R3K2R w Kkq - 0 1",
    "rnbqkbnr/pp1ppppp/8/2p5/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq c6 0 2",
    "8/PPPPPPPP/8/8/8/8/8/4K2k w - - 0 1",
    "rnbqkbnr/pppppppp/8/8/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq e3 0 1",
    "4k3/8/8/8/8/8/8/4K2R w K - 0 1",
    "4k3/8/8/8/8/8/8/R3K3 w Q - 0 1",
    "r3k2r/8/8/8/8/8/8/4K3 w kq - 0 1",
    "8/8/8/8/8/8/6k1/4K2R w K - 0 1",
    "8/2p5/3p4/KP5r/1R3p1k/8/4P1P1/8 w - - 0 1",
    "rnbqkbnr/pppp1ppp/8/4p3/4P3/8/PPPP1PPP/RNBQKBNR w KQkq e6 0 2",
    "1n1Qkb1r/ppp1pppp/8/8/8/8/PPPPPPPP/4K2R w K - 0 1",
    "r1bqkbnr/pppp1ppp/2n5/1B2p3/4P3/5N2/PPPP1PPP/RNBQK2R w KQkq - 4 4",
]

all_ok = True
for fen in tests:
    our = set(run_solution(fen))
    board = chess.Board(fen)
    ref = set()
    for move in board.legal_moves:
        if move.promotion and move.promotion != chess.QUEEN:
            continue
        bc = board.copy()
        bc.push(move)
        ref.add(" ".join(bc.fen().split(" ")[:-2]))
    ok = our == ref
    print(f"{'OK' if ok else 'FAIL'} {fen} our={len(our)} ref={len(ref)}")
    if not ok:
        all_ok = False
        print("  missing:", ref - our)
        print("  extra:", our - ref)
print("ALL OK" if all_ok else "SOME FAILED")
PY
